query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Clean up and enrich HubSpot CRM records by listing contacts and companies, matching contacts to companies, assigning segmentation values from job title and company industry, creating required CRM properties, updating contacts in bulk, creating associations, and attempting a later bulk import of companies and contacts.
query_ground_truth.query: update HubSpot contacts in bulk with associations
query_ground_truth.intent: Perform bulk updates on contact records, match them to their respective companies, and establish associations.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if target contact IDs are unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Build the contact ID list using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA (collect results[].id; paginate with the after cursor).

[Optional (if custom property internal name, options, or writability are unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Validate the property using HUBSPOT_LIST_CONTACT_PROPERTIES and HUBSPOT_READ_A_CRM_PROPERTY_BY_NAME (confirm it is not calculated/read-only).
[Required (before irreversible writes)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm final cohort size plus the exact property key/value and intended payload location (properties vs custom_properties).

[Required] [Step]: Batch update using HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CONTACTS (send inputs[].id with the custom property payload; chunk large cohorts), or use HUBSPOT_UPDATE_BATCH_OF_OBJECTS_BY_IDOR_PROPERTY_VALUES when matching by an alternate unique field.
[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Spot-check updated records using HUBSPOT_READ_CONTACTS (confirm the specific updated key/value).
[Fallback (if batch fails validation or partially fails)] [Fallback]: Remove/adjust the invalid field (then re-run the batch) and retry only failed records using HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CONTACT.
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CONTACTS] HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (READ_ONLY_VALUE) can occur if you try to set a calculated/read-only property; remove that field from the payload and retry.
[HUBSPOT_READ_A_CRM_PROPERTY_BY_NAME] calculated=true and/or modificationMetadata.readOnlyValue=true indicates the property cannot be written via updates.
[HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CONTACTS] Some custom fields only apply when placed under inputs[].custom_properties; using only inputs[].properties may return success without changing the intended field.
[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA] Use results[].id as the canonical identifier for updates; don’t rely on IDs embedded in arbitrary returned properties.
[HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CONTACT] Responses can include many system-managed properties; verify the intended field specifically in data.properties.

properties.description: Standard HubSpot contact properties to update. Use typed fields like firstname, lastname, email, phone, company, lifecyclestage, hs_lead_status, etc. Only include the properties you want to change.

custom_properties.description: Custom HubSpot properties to update. Use this for any custom properties you've created in your HubSpot account. Keys must be the internal property names (e.g., 'my_custom_field'). Values must be strings. Use HUBSPOT_LIST_CONTACT_PROPERTIES with custom_only=true to discover available custom property names. These are merged with standard properties before sending to the API.
